attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication on RHEL 9 across the cluster: node1 as writable primary, node2 and node3 as read-only async streaming standbys built via pg_basebackup with a dedicated SCRAM-authenticated replicator role. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys correctly reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol (node2, node3, node1) with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart proof of PostgreSQL/replication recovery on each node, finishing with an end-to-end write-and-propagate check across all three nodes.
